# web.uvic.ca

> > Self-serve web hosting platform for University of Victoria faculty, students, and staff, featuring academic course materials, educational software documentation, and research projects.

The web.uvic.ca domain hosts a diverse collection of UVic-affiliated content including course pages, the Hot Potatoes educational software suite documentation, research data centre resources, digital history projects, and personal academic websites. The platform supports SFTP access with PHP/Python capabilities for the UVic community.

## Key Topics

- University of Victoria (UVic)
- Hot Potatoes educational software
- SCORM 1.2 integration
- Data Mining course materials
- Vancouver Island Regional Science Fair
- Research Data Centre microdata access
- Chemistry 101 problem-solving tutorials
- JCloze and Masher tools
- Multilingual educational resources
- Digital history projects
- Self-serve web hosting
- Educational software tutorials
- Academic course pages
- SFTP and PHP/Python support

## Web Hosting & Platform Information

- [Self-serve web hosting - University Systems - UVic](https://web.uvic.ca): UVic self-serve web hosting for employees/students using SFTP and PHP/Python

## Academic Courses & Teaching Materials

- [Data Mining](https://web.uvic.ca/~nmehta/data_mining_spring2025): UVic CSC 503/SENG 474 Data Mining course page for Spring 2025 by Nishant Mehta
- [Chemistry 101: Problem Solving](https://web.uvic.ca/~mcindoe/rpsc.html): Chemistry 101 problem-solving tutorial using Read-Plan-Solve-Check method
- [Chemistry 101: Problem Solving - Chapter 2](https://web.uvic.ca/~mcindoe/rpsc2.html): Chemistry 101 Chapter 2 problem-solving guide on periodic properties and electrons
- [Chemistry 101: Problem Solving - Chapter 5](https://web.uvic.ca/~mcindoe/rpsc5.html): Chemistry 101 Chapter 5 problem-solving guide on intermolecular forces

## Hot Potatoes Educational Software

- [Hot Potatoes Version 7 Tutorials](https://web.uvic.ca/hrd/hotpot/tutorials7.php): Hot Potatoes v7 tutorials including SCORM, JCloze, and multilingual guides
- [Hot Potatoes Version 6 Tutorials](https://web.uvic.ca/hrd/hotpot/tutorials6.php): Hot Potatoes 6 tutorials covering Masher, SCORM integration, and Flash/MP3
- [Hot Potatoes General Tutorials](https://web.uvic.ca/hrd/hotpot/tutorials.htm): Hot Potatoes tutorials with Windows/Mac guides and multilingual translations
- [Half-Baked Hot Potatoes Tutorials](https://web.uvic.ca/hrd/halfbaked/tutorials.htm): Hot Potatoes tutorials for Windows/Mac with multilingual user contributions
- [Hot Potatoes Version 6 FAQ](https://web.uvic.ca/hrd/hotpot/v6_faq.php): Hot Potatoes v6 FAQ covering installation, platform compatibility, and SCORM

## Research & Academic Projects

- [Vancouver Island Regional Science Fair](https://web.uvic.ca/~virsf/index.php): Vancouver Island Regional Science Fair 2026 at UVic with registration info
- [Research Data Centre FAQ](https://web.uvic.ca/~rdc/FAQ.html): UVic Research Data Centre FAQ on microdata access and application process
- [Victoria's Victoria - Edges of Time](https://web.uvic.ca/vv/student/edges_of_time/about.html): UVic digital history project on Victorian-era Victoria, BC microhistory
